known_limitations.description: Client JA4 novelty is scored per source entity and is LEARN-ONLY until that entity's baseline is ready (both an observation count and an elapsed span); a low-traffic or newly seen entity therefore produces no JA4 finding by design. Standalone new-to-entity novelty is informational, not a C2 verdict, and JA4 never identifies a program, device or adversary. Legacy JA3 rarity, server fingerprint rarity, certificate anomalies, DoH and protocol heuristics are not e2e-verified; encrypted metadata visibility varies. Exfiltration tactic TA0010 is omitted.
Measured quality is computed by services/feedback-service/quality.py (KTD2); static confidence weights are not measured precision or false-positive rates.
